title: Writing Task 2 - Cultural Globalisation
description: IELTS Writing Task 2: Is cultural globalisation a positive or negative development for local cultures?

stimuli.title: Task 2: Cultural Globalisation — Threat or Opportunity?
stimuli.content:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

Write about the following topic:

As the world becomes increasingly connected, Western culture is spreading rapidly and local cultures are being threatened. Some people see this cultural globalisation as a positive development, while others believe it is harmful. Is cultural globalisation more of a positive or negative development?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

questionGroups.instruction: Write an essay evaluating whether cultural globalisation is more positive or negative.

questions.content: Is cultural globalisation more of a positive or negative development? Discuss and give your opinion.

bandDescriptors.taskResponse: Weigh both positive and negative aspects before stating a reasoned overall judgement
bandDescriptors.coherence: Move logically through benefits, drawbacks, and conclusion with clear signposting
bandDescriptors.lexicalResource: Use culturally relevant vocabulary: homogenisation, cultural heritage, indigenous, diaspora
bandDescriptors.grammaticalRange: Use a range of complex structures including relative clauses and passive constructions

sampleIdeas: Globalisation exposes people to diverse cultures, fostering mutual understanding and tolerance
Dominant cultures can overshadow smaller ones, leading to language extinction and lost traditions
The internet allows minority cultures to preserve and share their heritage globally
Local communities can adopt global influences while maintaining their unique identities
